neighbours.label: the first piece of a multi-token adverb in -ally / -ily at a point where an adverb is expected ('ideologically and occup|ationally', 'both economically and ge|ographically', 'even uncon|sciously')
fire: The valleys are divided both linguistically and geographically from the plain.
Teachers were sorted ideologically and occupationally by the new ministry.
The repair was done quickly and satisfactorily by the local firm.
People copy their parents consciously or unconsciously in most things.
The mound is important both historically and archaeologically.
The two islands differ chemically and geologically from the mainland.
The plant has been used culinarily and medicinally for centuries.
The reef is among the richest and most biologically varied in the ocean.
quiet: The valleys are divided by language and geography from the plain.
Teachers were sorted by ideology and occupation under the new ministry.
The repair was quick and satisfactory, said the local firm.
People copy their parents in conscious or unconscious ways.
The mound is important to history and archaeology.
The two islands differ in chemistry and geology from the mainland.
The plant has had culinary and medicinal uses for centuries.
The reef is among the richest in biological variety in the ocean.

notes: Last layer. Probes: ' occup'(ationally) 0.67, ' ge'(ographically) 0.62, ' satisf'(actorily) 0.62, ' uncon'(sciously) 0.56, ' archae'(ologically) 0.44, ' log'(istically) 0.20; when the second adverb is a single token the pole reads 0.08-0.33 on the ' and' before it; adverbs outside such a frame ('slide horizontally', 'chose arbitrarily') 0.00; adjective and noun forms 0.00. Whether a fire item works depends on how the tokenizer splits its adverb.
